item.title: The war in Iran raises pressure on Ukraine while Russia prepares new offensives
item.summary: With U.S.-brokered Ukraine peace talks on hold due to the war in the Middle East, Russian President Vladimir Putin is expected to try to expand his military gains via new offensives against his southern neighbor that will put even more pressure on Kyiv

item.title: US strike on a suspected drug boat off Costa Rica leaves 2 dead, 1 critically hurt
item.summary: Costa Rican authorities say a U.S. strike on a suspected drug-smuggling boat off the country's coast has left at least two people dead and one critically injured

item.summary: A Russian drone strike on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed at least two people and wounded two children Saturday, a regional official said, as a Ukrainian delegation headed to the United States for talks aimed at restarting stalled peace negot...

item.title: Iranian diaspora marks Nowruz with heavy hearts as war cuts contact with loved ones
item.summary: Iranians living abroad are approaching Persian new year with grief and fear as war and a crackdown cut them off from loved ones inside Iran

item.title: North Korean leader Kim and his daughter ride a tank together during army training
item.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and his teenage daughter have ridden a tank together, days after they watched rocket launches and fired pistols

item.title: Russia thwarts protests over the blocking of a popular messaging app, but frustration persists
item.summary: Authorities in nearly a dozen regions across Russian have refused to authorize protests in recent weeks over internet censorship and the blocking of Telegram, a popular messaging app

item.title: At least 17 dead in fighting on Sudan's border with Chad, aid group says
item.summary: Attacks on a town along Sudan’s border with Chad have killed at least 17 people and injured 123, Doctors Without Borders, or MSF, said

item.title: Tons of aid flows into Cuba as humanitarian convoy arrives on the struggling island
item.summary: Some 650 delegates from 33 countries and 120 organizations have started arriving in Cuba as part of a solidarity caravan transporting some 20 tons of humanitarian aid as the island grapples with a severe energy crisis

item.title: Under siege by a Mexican cartel, these civilians fight back with AK-47s and grenades
item.summary: Residents in the Mexican central state of Guerrero are setting up self-defense patrols to keep a powerful cartel out of their mountain towns

item.title: Civil lawsuit in London against Gerry Adams’ alleged IRA role is dropped
item.summary: Three victims of bombings in England by the Irish Republican Army have brought an end to their damages claim against former Sinn Féin leader Gerry Adams
